हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: The Substitute Sister is a gripping family drama of betrayal, sacrifice, and forbidden love. When poor and innocent Anaya is forced to replace her wealthy twin sister Shanaya in a powerful marriage, she becomes trapped in a web of lies, greed, and emotional torture. But as she starts falling for Ishaan—the husband meant for Shanaya—truths unravel, loyalties shift, and destiny tests the limits of blood, love, and survival.
